segments.name: Inspection and Heat-Treating
products: Laboratory Services, including Metallurgical and Tensile Services
segments.description: Provides conventional and advanced inspection, heat-treating, and digital imaging services for process, pipeline, power, aerospace and other industries.
segments.evidence: IHT provides conventional and advanced non-destructive testing services primarily for the process, pipeline and power sectors, pipeline integrity management services, and field heat-treating services, as well as associated engineering and condition assessment services.

segments.name: Mechanical Services
products: Vapor Barrier Plug and Weld Testing Services
segments.description: Provides onstream leak repair and composite solutions and specialty maintenance, turnaround and outage services to keep customers' critical assets running and reduce downtime.
segments.evidence: MS provides onstream services engineered to keep customer assets on-line and producing, and specialty maintenance, turnaround and outage services, which are performed while assets are off-line, and are designed to reduce customer downtime.

revenueModel.text: Heavy industrial customers pay Team for specialty industrial services, generally billed on a time and materials basis under purchase orders issued pursuant to written customer agreements.
revenueModel.evidence: Generally, customers are billed on a time and materials basis, although some work may be performed pursuant to a fixed-price bid.
